question: Should storage/storj-sia-origrid-swisstransfer-transfer-it-fails-quota take its own entity in registry/entities.tsv (as ip-proxy/clouds-as-exit-sources and ip-proxy/host-asn-field-absent do), rather than be split?
why: It is a five-provider rejection row and every provider has its own record (storj-object-storage-standard, sia-storage-app, origrid, swisstransfer, transfer-it). Today it resolves by name prefix to entity storj-3 with alias 'storj / sia / origrid / swisstransfer / transfer.it', so a search for Storj, Sia or Origrid lists it beside the real records. Splitting would only duplicate those records; an entity row named like 'Storj, Sia, Origrid, SwissTransfer, transfer.it rejection row (survey)' keeps it out of the single-provider searches. Needs a registry row (outside a lane's scope).
